dogecoin.text:
$TSLA #DOGE coin from last night "Saturday Night Live"

Host: What is #dogecoin?
#Musk: It's the future of currency. It's an unstoppable financial vehicle that’s going to take over the world

#MichaelChe: So, it's a hustle?
#Musk: Yeah, it's a hustle [laughed]
$TSLA Tesla chief and cryptocurrency supporter Elon Musk called #DOGE coin a ‘hustle’ during his guest-host spot on the “Saturday Night Live” comedy sketch TV show.
$COIN Coinbase Says Dogecoin (Doge) Is Launching On Coinbase Pro

$TSLA Tesla CEO Elon Musk reiterated support for #Bitcoin, #Ethereum, and #Dogecoin at the online B Word conference Wednesday, saying he personally would lose money in the cryptos lost value and that Tesla will resume taking payments in #Bitcoin
$EBON  has completed the designing of a chip for simultaneous Litecoin (LTC) and Dogecoin (Doge) mining as an addition to our current portfolio of cryptocurrency mining chip designs.
$AMC Dogecoin is jumping after AMC Entertainment(AMC) CEO Adam Aron tweeted that the company needs to "figure out a way" to accept payment in the cryptocurrency.

$HOOD Shiba Inu coin -- like dogecoin, an homage to the Japanese dog breed -- is surging in value but Robinhood hasn't added Shiba Inu to its platform and is missing out on demand for the digital asset.

$HOOD Robinhood is missing out on crypto's new top dog. Nearly two-thirds of the trading app's cryptocurrency revenue in the third quarter was attributable to #dogecoin transactions, a parody token named after an internet meme centered on the image of a Shiba Inu dog
The US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has postponed deciding on whether to greenlight two proposed cryptocurrency exchange-traded funds (ETFs) holding Dogecoin and XRP
